facts.fact: Lucy 天亮醒来时 Saskia 已经走了，毯子盖在她身上，茶几上用奇多拼出 THX, BYE。
facts.anchor: When Lucy opens her eyes to the morning’s brightness, Saskia is gone.

facts.fact: Lucy 洗澡吃早饭，然后骑车出门买炖鸡汤的食材。
facts.anchor: She showers, eats breakfast, and heads to the store for ingredients.

facts.fact: Lucy 骑回自己那条街，看见车道上停着一辆警车。
两名警察在门廊上等 Lucy，女警先开口确认她是不是 Lucy Haskell。
Dover 直接说明来意：新业主请来的园林工在宅子院子里发现了一具尸体。
facts.anchor: “I’m going to get right to the point. The new owners brought in some landscapers, and they found a body.”

facts.fact: Dover 追问 Lucy 的母亲当年是不是失踪了。
警方说尸体的伤指向头部钝器重击致死，并追问祖父有没有推她下楼或拿过凶器。
facts.anchor: The injuries to the body suggested death by blunt force trauma to the head.

facts.fact: 警察走后 Lucy 用空气清新剂喷满屋子，想把他们的气味赶出去。
facts.anchor: She sprays Febreze all around to get the ghost of their shittiness out of the air.

facts.fact: Lucy 在厨房用力剁菜时，刀片扎进了自己的指甲。
facts.anchor: There is a knife blade stuck in her fingernail.

facts.fact: 章末 Lucy 下楼找 Saskia，认定自己碎得彻底，而 Saskia 别无选择只能把她修好。
facts.anchor: She is so very broken, and Saskia will have no choice but to fix her.
